scope: NIFTY and SENSEX opening-ATM conditional exit panel; full-entry book unavailable
costs: Current per-exchange native fee schedule, fixed at each entry; not reconstructed historical fees
signal: Inherited three-observation median of put-call parity; future equals proxy, no independent confirmation
admissions: Frozen panel.py BREAK 3x band and MOMENTUM 2x band; paired exits only; no failed-break in panel
ordinary: Decide at completed ten-second close; pending market order fills following bar open +/- inherited NIFTY p75 half spread, reported at execution-bar completion
adverse: Same decisions; pending orders use following bar high for buy, low for sell, twice the inherited spread
sensex_spreads: NIFTY calibrated table transferred provisionally; unverified BFO spread, adverse doubles it
participation: 20% of completed decision bar volume for sizing; at most 20% of next execution bar for fills; whole lots; actual depth unknown
terminal: Flatten decision from 15:29:30; no synthetic final sale; remainder unresolved with separate full-premium loss bound
coverage: Primary requires every paired ten-second grid point 12:58:50-15:29:50 and no invalid OHLC/volume. Missing individual seconds remain flagged, never filled
source_reads: Authoritative CSV file list only; immutable selected copies, no database writes or API calls

windows.validation: 2026-07-01 through latest acquired 2026-10-01 except seen NIFTY Sep 8,15,22,29

results: Independent possibly overlapping pockets. Panel totals and cumulative session-summed drawdown are not portfolio profit or realizable account drawdown
